fieldNotes.location: UNRESOLVED. Danone announced a new Jacksonville-area regional distribution center in June 2025 alongside the $65M plant expansion at 2198 W. Beaver Street, but no street address, business park, or building has been publicly disclosed as of the audit date (May 2026). Searched Danone newsroom/PRNewswire releases, Jax Daily Record, Jacksonville Today, and trade press (Food Dive, ProFood World, Supply Chain Digital) - all describe the DC only in general terms ('a new regional distribution center in the Jacksonville area, rooted in regional infrastructure'). The facility appears to be under construction / ramp-up with no findable location.
fieldNotes.classification: All 22 classification fields default to false/NONE/null because no facility could be located or imaged. Every field is listed in uncertainFields. urbanRural defaulted to 'Urban' as a placeholder (Jacksonville metro) but is itself uncertain.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Re-audit once Danone or the City of Jacksonville publishes the DC address (likely via a building permit, lease announcement, or the Danone careers 'Our Locations' page once the site is operational).
